extracted.intended_audience: writers, translators, publishers, and nominators interested in PEN America Literary Awards
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and high-level criteria for works submitted or nominated to the PEN America Literary Awards, including who judges entries, eligible genres, and the publication-year-based submission cycle. Intended to orient authors, translators, and publishers about award scope and timing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognition of outstanding voices across diverse genres
rubrics_metrics.description: "Since 1963, the PEN America Literary Awards have honored many of the most outstanding voices in literature across diverse genres, including fiction, poetry, science writing, essays, sports writing, biography, children’s literature, and drama."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards are intended to recognize exceptional literary quality across a broad set of genres; entrants should be strong examples of literary excellence in one of the listed genres.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and type of awards (winners, fellowships, grants, prizes)
rubrics_metrics.description: "PEN America confers over 20 distinct awards, fellowships, grants and prizes each year, awarding nearly $315,000 to writers and translators."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple award types exist (prizes, fellowships, grants); eligibility and reward levels vary by award — entrants should review individual award descriptions to determine fit (e.g., prize vs. fellowship vs. grant).

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection process: juried by panels of literary professionals
rubrics_metrics.description: "Our awards are juried by panels of esteemed, award-winning writers, editors, booksellers, and critics."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions are evaluated by peer panels and professionals; applicants should expect literary assessment by writers/editors/critics rather than public voting — emphasis on artistic and critical judgment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication-year-based submission cycles and timing
rubrics_metrics.description: "Submissions and nominations for the 2019 awards cycle (for books published in 2018) will be accepted starting..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility is tied to the book's publication year and to specific submission windows; entrants must submit within the stated cycle for the relevant publication year and watch deadlines for each awards cycle.
